chunks: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrated from his father, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa al-Ash'ari, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Uqbah ibn Ja'far, who said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): 'You have reached the age you have reached, yet you have no child.' He replied: 'O Uqbah ibn Ja'far, the master of this command (the Imam) will not die until he sees his son after him.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Rida say about having a son before his death?
ai.summary: Although the chain of narration (isnad) traces back to Imam al-Rida, the content is traditionally cited in discussions regarding the Imamate of Imam Hasan al-Askari (a.s) to address the doubt of his childlessness during the period of the Minor Exile (al-Ghaybah al-Sughra). The Imam affirms that the holder of the Command (Sahib al-Amr) will not die until he sees his son, thereby guaranteeing the continuity of the Imamate through progeny and resolving the theological concern regarding the potential end of the line of Imams.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 184 - Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Ja’far Himyari has narrated from his father from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Isa Ashari from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr from Uqbah bin Ja’far that he said:
I asked Imam Ali Ridha (a.s): “You have reached this stage, but you don’t have an issue?” He replied: “O Uqbah bin Ja’far, the Imam does not pass away before seeing his descendant [successor].”
